summary: An engineer who became an enterprise architect, then an executive leader. Two decades in, still building people, developing leaders, and pushing engineering execution to a higher standard. That work started hands-on, moved through director- and VP-level leadership, and now shows up in designing the organization, architecture, and operating model behind Experity's engineering teams. AI-assisted engineering is the latest version of the same pattern, and it holds across every organization along the way: strengthen technical judgment, clarify ownership, and build leaders who can carry the work forward independently.

hero.tagline: Builds stronger leaders and stronger engineering systems.
